title: Bacchanal
summary: BAC'CHANAL, BACCHANA'LIAN, noun [from Bacchus, Gr., the deity of wine and revelling. Latin poculum.] One who indulges in drunken revels; a drunkard; one who is noisy and riotous, when intoxicated. BAC

inlines.v: BAC'CHANAL, BACCHANA'LIAN, noun [from Bacchus, Gr., the deity of wine and revelling. Latin poculum.] One who indulges in drunken revels; a drunkard; one who is noisy and riotous, when intoxicated. BAC'CHANAL, BACCHANA'LIAN, adjective Revelling in intemperate drinking; riotous; noisy. BACCHANA'LIAN, adjective Pertaining to reveling and drunkenness. Even bacchanalian madness has its charms.
